color.note: The printer burns a dot or it doesn't. ink and paper are pure; tone-* greys are rendered as grey and dithered by the print pipeline. canvas-* tokens are screen-only.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The receipt itself: every print background, and the plate behind text that sits over a tone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Every solid mark: text, rules, solid bars and blocks. Text sits on paper or on ink, never on a tone. Paper text on ink is set 700 (unverified, see To verify).

tokens.name: tone-15
tokens.usage: Lightest tone: quiet backgrounds, QR placeholder. May print near-white after dithering (unverified).

tokens.name: tone-35
tokens.usage: Light tone: skipped days, secondary marks in small cells.

tokens.name: tone-50
tokens.usage: Mid tone: previous period in charts, focus blocks, below-target bars.

tokens.name: tone-65
tokens.usage: Dark tone: degraded cells, removed lines. Must stay distinct from ink on paper (unverified).

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen only: the desk the strip lies on in previews. Never printed.

tokens.name: canvas-ink
tokens.usage: Screen only: captions and strip labels on canvas (13:1).

tokens.name: canvas-muted
tokens.usage: Screen only: design notes on canvas (6.2:1).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Archivo at font-stretch 62% (condensed), weight 900; bundle.css applies the stretch. Line heights are whole pixels. Smear under 900 strokes is untested (see To verify).

styles.name: display-mega
styles.usage: Single-glyph heroes: a severity number inside an ink block.

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero numerals: rank, temperature, a countdown.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The ID or day name that heads an event print (ticket, briefing).

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Receipt titles: TASKS, AGENDA, SEPTEMBER, a focus task.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Deadline figures inside callouts; two-line titles.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Secondary stats, service names, sprint name on a banner.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono. Weights are provisional: stem width in dots per size has not been measured (see To verify). Target is 2-dot stems.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Payment webhook retries exceed limit on EU cluster
styles.usage: The one-sentence summary under a display ID.

styles.name: item
styles.usage: List item titles: tasks, PRs, ingredients.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Raised retry cap to 8 and added jitter.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Values in leader rows, timestamps, emphasis.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section labels and header bars, uppercase.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Metadata under an item, footers, legends.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Axis ticks only. Never body text.

groups.name: Text mode
groups.note: Screen preview of the printer's built-in Font A (12 x 24-dot cell, 32 columns). JetBrains Mono only stands in on screen; real output is sent as ESC/POS text, never rasterized.

styles.name: textmode
styles.usage: Preview of a native text line: 32 columns, 12 x 24-dot cell.

styles.name: textmode-double
styles.usage: Preview of Font A at double width and height: 16 columns, 24 x 48-dot cell.

spacing.note: Dots, not CSS pixels: 8 dots = 1 mm. Paper margins come from the strip; inside it, stack on these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked bars, diff squares.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tag padding, label to rule, legend swatch gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows inside a section; tile padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: List row padding, tile padding (horizontal), gap beside a glyph.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Under a masthead's heavy rule.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Before a stat grid, callout or quote — a big section break.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Strip side and top margin (on-screen preview only; the printer has its own).

tokens.name: space-feed
tokens.usage: Blank feed after the last line so the tear clears the content.

radius.note: None. Dots are square, corners are square.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything. Curves stair-step at 203 dpi; use them only inside type.

stroke.note: Minimum stroke is 2 dots. Erosion trims the bottom dot of vertical runs of 3+ dots, so horizontal rules of 3px and up may print a dot thinner; under test (TestStrokes).

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dashed list dividers, leaders, cell and tag outlines, note lines.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Section rules, event boxes, strike-through.

tokens.name: stroke-box
tokens.usage: Stat tile grids, checkboxes, chart baselines, tear line.

tokens.name: stroke-heavy
tokens.usage: Callout boxes (THE ONE THING, ACK REQUIRED), banner column heads.

tokens.name: stroke-bar
tokens.usage: The rule under a masthead. One per receipt.

tokens.name: paper-width
tokens.usage: Printable width: 48 mm at 203 dpi. Every layout is exactly this wide.

tokens.name: strip-width
tokens.usage: On-screen strip including 32px margins standing in for the unprintable edge.

tokens.name: textmode-columns
tokens.usage: Characters per line in the printer's native font.

tokens.name: qr-size
tokens.usage: QR placeholder slot. Module size (dots per module) is under test (TestQR).

tokens.name: checkbox
tokens.usage: Hollow pen checkbox (outer, with 4px border).
